# AIMETRA — Institutional Intelligence Layer

> AI & ML Education, Talent, Research & Analytics
> Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

## About AIMETRA
AIMETRA is the purpose-built intelligence ecosystem connecting students, faculty, research, projects, opportunities, alumni, and institutional data into one structured academic environment.

## Core Capabilities
- **Academic Programs**: Undergraduate (B.Tech in CSE - AI & ML), Graduate (M.Tech in Advanced Machine Learning), and Doctoral (Ph.D.) degrees.
- **Research Laboratories**: High-Performance GPU Computing Cluster (NVIDIA DGX), Autonomous Systems & Robotics Arena, Edge AI & TinyML Lab, Center for Healthcare AI, Natural Language Processing Center.
- **Talent Intelligence**: Multi-criteria student performance evaluation (AHP + TOPSIS algorithms) combining academic coursework, peer-reviewed publications, open-source repositories, and verified technical competencies.
- **AIDA (AIMETRA Intelligence & Data Assistant)**: Context-aware conversational intelligence assistant providing authenticated department leadership, faculty mentors, and students with evidence-based query capabilities over institutional records.

## Governance & Ethics
AIMETRA maintains strict institutional data protection, cryptographic audit logs for credential issuance, role-based access control, and privacy standards aligned with institutional charters.
